guides.title: Three perfect days in San Francisco, from Telegraph Hill to the Golden Gate
guides.dek: Beat-era North Beach on Friday, a Día de los Muertos concert at Davies Symphony Hall on Saturday, and on Sunday a coffee festival at Fort Mason and a walk along the bay to the Golden Gate Bridge.

guides.title: Three perfect days in Los Angeles, from Exposition Park to the Pacific
guides.dek: George Lucas's new museum, Brahms at Disney Hall with the LA Phil's next music director, a long warm Saturday on the Westside and the Fugees' The Score at the Hollywood Bowl.

guides.title: Three perfect days in Miami: museums, Coral Gables and Wynwood
guides.dek: Picasso, Klee and Matisse from Berlin at PAMM, a swim in a 1920s coral-rock pool, salsa on Calle Ocho, a seafood festival in Wynwood and NASCAR's title weekend down in Homestead.

guides.title: Three perfect days in New York, from the Bowery to the harbor
guides.dek: Brancusi's studio rebuilt at MoMA, the New York Comedy Festival's opening weekend, Wynton Marsalis above Columbus Circle and a free ferry past the Statue of Liberty at dusk.

guides.title: Three perfect days in Paris, in the year photography turns 200
guides.dek: The Marais on Friday, Rodin, Monet and a free night of photographs on Saturday, and the Canal Saint-Martin on Sunday, in the quiet week before Paris Photo.

guides.title: Three perfect days in London: fireworks, poppies and Istanbul
guides.dek: A Remembrance weekend in London: Westminster on a wet Friday, the northern heights and Ally Pally's fireworks on Saturday, and the Cenotaph and the V&A's new Istanbul show on Sunday.

guides.title: Three perfect days in Prague: piano, goose and the north bank
guides.dek: The first St. Martin's goose menus land on Friday, a piano festival fills the Rudolfinum, and the art is up the hill in Holešovice. Here is a weekend in the Old Town, Letná and Žižkov.

guides.title: Three perfect days in Las Vegas: bulls, Boulder City and the Fugees' Score
guides.dek: The SEMA Show opens its doors to the public, the PBR crowns its team champions on the Strip, and Lauryn Hill and Wyclef Jean play The Score at 30. Fit in a morning at Hoover Dam between the shows.

guides.title: Three perfect days in San Francisco, Halloween edition
guides.dek: Lakers at Chase Center, a Castro block party on Halloween night, Día de los Muertos altars from SoMa to the Outer Sunset, and an extra hour on Sunday to spend in Golden Gate Park.

guides.title: Three perfect days in Los Angeles: Halloween and the Day of the Dead
guides.dek: Halloween lands on a Saturday and Día de los Muertos fills Sunday, so LA gets a long weekend of costumes, candlelit altars and, with rain likely, some very good museums.

guides.title: Three perfect days in Miami: Halloween weekend
guides.dek: Cafecito on Calle Ocho, a closing-day farewell at PAMM, stone crabs and a costume party on Lincoln Road, then a slow Sunday in Coconut Grove as the clocks fall back.

guides.title: Three perfect days in New York: Halloween, then the marathon
guides.dek: A Friday of museums and Grand Central, a Saturday that ends on Sixth Avenue for the Village Halloween Parade, and a Sunday in Brooklyn cheering the marathon, with an extra hour to spare.

guides.title: Three perfect days in Paris
guides.dek: A long Toussaint weekend of Zurbarán, Cassatt and Cézanne, walk-in bistro lunches, chocolate at Porte de Versailles and chrysanthemums in Montmartre.

guides.title: Three perfect days in London
guides.dek: Agatha Christie arrives at the British Library, Korea fills the British Museum and the Thames goes dark by five. A Halloween weekend of museums, markets, a proper pub and a Sunday roast.

guides.title: Three perfect days in Prague
guides.dek: Candles on the graves, a queen's portrait show at the foot of the Castle, Debussy at the National Theatre and the last farmers' market of October on the river: Prague turns inward, and it suits the city.

guides.title: Three perfect days in Las Vegas: Halloween on the Strip and downtown
guides.dek: A Nevada Day hockey matinee, Metallica inside Sphere on Halloween night, a morning among the red cliffs and a Día de los Muertos Sunday downtown, with an extra hour of sleep thrown in.
